_readme: COPY THIS FILE to add a new client. Name it after the business, e.g. mi-taller.json.
Files that start with _ are ignored, so this template never goes live.
id:               lowercase letters, numbers and dashes only. It appears in the web address.
vertical:         dental | medical | home_services | auto | legal | general
language:         es | en. Idioma del PANEL y de los avisos por SMS al negocio.
NO afecta al publico: a cada persona se le contesta en su idioma.
timezone:         America/New_York (Miami), America/Chicago, America/Los_Angeles ...
hours:            all seven days are required. Use null when the business is closed.
qualifierOptions: the list of things the assistant checks against. It changes by vertical:
dental / medical -> insurance plans accepted
home_services    -> cities and areas served
auto             -> makes serviced
legal            -> states and areas served
general          -> leave it empty
offers:           only prices written here are ever quoted. Leave it empty if unsure.
twilioNumber:     the Twilio number for this business, +1 followed by 10 digits.
(alerts are texted to FRONT_DESK_PHONE in .env; leave it empty to turn them off)
allowedOrigins:   the client's real website, e.g. ["https://www.theirsite.com"].
Then add the dashboard password to .env:  BUSINESS_<ID>_PASSWORD=something-long
using the id in capitals with dashes as underscores, e.g. BUSINESS_MI_TALLER_PASSWORD.
name: Business Name
extraNotes: Anything else the assistant should know: parking, languages, payment methods.

greeting.web: Hi! I'm the virtual assistant for Business Name. ¿Prefiere español? How can I help?
greeting.sms: Hi, this is Business Name - sorry we missed your call! How can we help? / ¡Hola! Perdón por no contestar, ¿en qué le ayudamos? Reply STOP to opt out.
